name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-ptooie-spike-ball
title: Redrawn Styled Ptooie + Spike Ball
description:
Custom redrawn graphics meant for Romi's SMB3 Ptooie Piranha Plant custom sprite, as well for the spike ball the enemy uses.

A custom palette for rows 9, C and D is included.

Finally, the spike ball itself is Exanimated, so a test level + screenshot has been included for the sake of helping setting it up better.

Credit's not necessary but heavily appreciated regardless.
